selection_rule: 80th percentile of scores in the prior calibration slice
purge_method: actual executable target exit must precede calibration or test boundary
fit_weighting: average inverse target-interval concurrency normalized to mean one
cost_stress_method: Do not refit scores; subtract incremental two-sided slippage from each realized target using executable entry
multiple_testing_warning: Only 1h can pass; 4h/12h/48h are diagnostics and cannot select a model or target.
